## Key Code

### (1) Tick loop — interval + phase
- `waveTick()` — `index.ts:219-234`. Guard `if (!turnActive || !tui) return;` (221). Phase advance `wavePhase += 0.6` (222). Loop over `tracked`: `if (inst.isStreaming && thinkingOnly(inst)) inst.invalidate();` (224-229) — only thinking-only streaming instances invalidated (cheap rebuild; once text streams, shimmer freezes). Then `tui.requestRender()` (230) — **called unconditionally every tick**, even when nothing invalidated.
- `startWave()` — `index.ts:236-239`: `if (waveTimer || !waveEnabled || !waveEnabledNow()) return; waveTimer = setInterval(waveTick, waveMs);` — does NOT require a TUI ref; waveTick no-ops without one.
- `stopWave()` — `index.ts:245-250`: clearInterval + null.
- `waveEnabledNow()` — `index.ts:241-243`: `enabled && waveEnabled`.
- Tick rate: `waveMs = Math.max(50, cfg.waveMs ?? 80)` (`index.ts:86`) — default 80ms, floor 50ms. Header comment says "~130ms" (line 25) — stale.

### (2) Per-char ANSI emitter — `liveLabel()` `index.ts:115-149`
- Raw label: `inst.__tlRaw` lowercased (116); frozen → `inst.__tlFrozen` (119-120); histDur hit → reconstructed duration label (122-124); non-streaming → `"thought ▸"` (125-127).
- Wave branch (`index.ts:128-142`): requires `waveEnabled && getTui()`. Regex `/^(.*?\S)(\s*▸\s*)$/s` (130) splits trailing `▸` into a **static** `suffix` (appended raw at 141). `animatePart = prefix + text` (131) — the prefix includes the 󰧑 glyph + space (`index.ts:82`), so **the 󰧑 glyph IS animated** (part of animatePart; astral codepoint survives `[...spread]` at 135).
- Emitter (135-140): per char `Math.sin(i * 0.9 - wavePhase) < -0.5 ? "\x1b[2m${ch}\x1b[22m" : ch` — **faint troughs only** (SGR 2 + explicit 22 reset); no bold crest is emitted despite the doc comment "faint → normal → bold crest" (line 26) — stale.
- Fallbacks wrap as `` `${prefix}${label}` `` (146, 148). If disabled: returns raw unstyled (117).

### (3) Accessor feeding pi's render — `instrument()` `index.ts:181-195`
First `updateContent` call per instance: reads current own data prop `hiddenThinkingLabel` (185-186), then `Object.defineProperty(inst, "hiddenThinkingLabel", { get: () => liveLabel(inst), set: v => inst.__tlRaw = ... })` (187-193). pi's own class-field data property is shadowed by this own accessor; pi's bake inside `updateContent` reads through the getter → animated string lands in the baked Text node.

### (4) Freeze/stop lifecycle
- **Install at load**: `installed = install()` at `index.ts:320` (before session_start so resumed blocks instrument on first bake); retry at `session_start:323`.
- `agent_start` (`index.ts:348-370`): `turnActive = true`, reset `reqStartMs`/`respEndMs` (349-351); sweeps still-unfrozen non-streaming instances (no histDur) to `"thought ▸"` + re-bake (354-367); **`startWave()` at line 369 — the only wave timer start**.
- `before_provider_request` (372-374) / `after_provider_response` (376-378): first-roundtrip window = thinking-phase duration.
- `agent_end` (`index.ts:380-404`): `turnActive = false` (381); **`stopWave()` at 382 — the primary timer stop**; duration = `(respEndMs − reqStartMs)` else `(now − reqStartMs)` else null (384-389); freezes all unfrozen non-hist instances to `thought · Xs ▸` / `thought ▸` (395-401); `reRenderTracked()` (403).
- `/thought-label` command (406-419): toggles `enabled`; `if (!enabled) stopWave();` (413) — second stop path.
- Wrapper-level freeze: hist-dur instances freeze inside the `updateContent` wrap (277-284) + re-bake via `orig.call` (281).

### (5) Config knobs
- `ThoughtLabelConfig` — `index.ts:57-62`: `briefMaxS?`, `briefText?`, `wave?: boolean`, `waveMs?: number`.
- Loaded from `~/.pi/agent/thought-label.json` (`CONFIG_PATH`, `index.ts:64`) via `loadTierConfig` (75-77; `lib/tier-glyphs.ts:25-33`, safe-JSON, `{}` on corrupt).
- `waveEnabled = cfg.wave !== false` (85, default ON); `waveMs = Math.max(50, cfg.waveMs ?? 80)` (86).
- Glyph: `tierCfg = { tier: "nerd", nerdGlyph: "󰧑", ...cfg }` (81) → `resolveTierGlyph(tierCfg, { unicode: "\u2615" })` (82; `lib/tier-glyphs.ts:35-43` — nerd→nerdGlyph, else unicode ☕, ascii→empty). `disabled` → `enabled=false` (78).

## Entry-point chain (label → pi render)
`pi` default export (`index.ts:74`) → `install()` at load (320) replaces **`AssistantMessageComponent.prototype.updateContent`** (291; idempotency tag `__thoughtLabelPatch`, 259/290). pi calls `updateContent` per streaming delta / expand-collapse. Wrap order (266-289): `instrument(this)` (268) → `orig.call` (272; internals read `this.hiddenThinkingLabel` → our accessor → `liveLabel()`) → `stripItalics(this)` (274; ANSI-stripped-plain match at 166-167, drops `[3m`/`[23m` because chalk rewrites in-string italic cancels) → optional hist freeze + second `orig.call` (277-284). Render refresh during wave: `waveTick` → `inst.invalidate()` + `tui.requestRender()`; TUI ref captured by wrapping **`InteractiveMode.prototype.mountInteractiveTui`** (`captureTui()`, 197-212) into `globalThis.__thoughtLabelTui` (101-104) so it survives `/reload` closure generations.

## Architecture
State: `tracked: Set` of instrumented instances (90), `waveTimer`/`wavePhase` (105-106), `turnActive`/`reqStartMs`/`respEndMs`/`lastDurText` (110-113), `histDur: Map<message, label>` reconstructed at session_start from branch-entry timestamp gaps (329-344). Data flow per tick: setInterval → waveTick → invalidate(thinking-only streaming) → pi re-render → `updateContent` wrap → orig bakes → getter `liveLabel()` → phase-shifted faint SGR per char → static `▸` suffix → stripItalics byte-patch. Freeze flow: agent_end stamps `__tlFrozen` on all turn instances so the getter short-circuits (119-120) and the wave branch is unreachable.

## Risks
- **Re-entrancy**: none direct — waveTick only invalidates; bake happens in pi's render pass. `reRenderTracked` (301-313) deliberately calls `origUpdate` (unwrapped) to avoid re-entering the freeze logic; hist re-bake at 281 runs after `__tlFrozen` is set so the second bake can't recurse.
- **Timer leak window**: `stopWave` fires only on `agent_end` (382) and `/thought-label` disable (413). If the process dies mid-turn or `/reload` swaps closure generations mid-turn, the old generation's interval persists until its own agent_end; waveTick is guarded by `turnActive`/tui but the interval handle isn't reaped on reload. `startWave` is single-instance via `waveTimer` null-check (237) — no stacking.
- **Render churn**: `tui.requestRender()` (230) fires every 80ms for the whole turn, even when zero instances qualified for invalidation (e.g., after text starts streaming) — wasted frames on long turns.
- **Stale docs**: header comment "~130ms" (line 25) vs actual 80ms default; "bold crest" (line 26) vs faint-only emitter (138).
- **Fragile seams**: prototype shape of `AssistantMessageComponent.updateContent` and `InteractiveMode.mountInteractiveTui` (capability-probed, self-disabling with notice at 255-257/296); own-accessor trick depends on pi baking through `this.hiddenThinkingLabel` per instance.
- `wavePhase` grows unbounded (+0.6/tick) — float-precision non-issue in practice.

`extensions/thought-label/index.ts:115-149` (`liveLabel`) — the wave emitter and accessor getter; every other piece (instrument, tick, freeze, config) exists to feed or gate this function.
